text: Teaching assistant for EE709, Testing and Verification of VLSI Circuits, and extending the DDR4 receiver towards CTLE–DFE–CDR integration.
Finished my research visit at LSI, École Polytechnique, on a first-principles study of monolayer MoS₂.
Completed a 10-bit differential SAR ADC for Mixed-Signal VLSI Design: 62.475 dB SNDR and 10.084-bit ENOB.
Started my dual degree project on a 1.6 Gbps DDR4 PHY receiver front-end.
Fellow at the NUS Young Fellowship Programme in Singapore.
